title: NeuroFlow Common Definitions
description: Shared primitives reused by the NeuroFlow workflow, tool, and heuristic schemas (specification 0.1).

specVersion.description: NeuroFlow specification version this document targets.

documentId.description: Stable, namespace-qualified document identifier (reverse-DNS, URI-like, or registry-qualified).

localId.description: Local identifier for an input, context field, step, output, or parameter within a single document.

qualifiedType.description: Namespace-qualified type string. The core: and neuro: namespaces are closed vocabularies defined by this specification; any other namespace denotes an open extension type. Arrays use the container form core:array<element-type>.

specType.description: A scalar or array type drawn from the spec-defined core: and neuro: vocabularies.

extensionType.description: A type contributed by a third-party namespace (any namespace other than core: or neuro:), in scalar or core:array<...> container form.

reference.description: Statically analyzable dot-path reference to a declared workflow value.

stepOutputReference.description: Dot-path reference that must resolve to a step output.

binding.description: Supplies a concrete value for a tool input. Exactly one of ref or constant.

constant.description: Fixed value passed to the tool input.

typeDeclaration.description: Describes the expected shape of a declared value.

optional.description: Whether the value can be omitted.

default.description: Default value when the declared value is absent.

extensions.description: Namespace-keyed extension metadata. Keys MUST be namespace strings; unknown namespaces MUST be preserved and MUST NOT change core validation.
